verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street says it offers green card pathways alongside visas "at any point in their U.S. immigration journey," and publishes an O-1 vs EB-1 comparison resource, so a green-card track exists in its own offering. However, nothing documents an actual O-1-to-green-card continuation strategy, and EB-2 NIW is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of O-1 → EB-1A sequencing strategy, any EB-2 NIW coverage, detail on how O-1 evidence carries over into a green-card petition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: We offer a suite of visas and green card pathways for technologists at any point in their U.S. immigration journey
